updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A weak authorization flaw in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation in their on-premises or hybrid Exchange deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Admin Assignment Time Limit
updates.summary: Purview now allows administrators to set an expiration date when assigning users and security groups to role groups, enabling temporary admin access grants with automatic revocation. This enhances security posture by reducing standing privilege grants and supporting zero-trust principles.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Role Management Enhancements
updates.summary: A new view-only role has been introduced in Purview that grants read-only visibility into member assignments across Purview and Defender, and this capability is now also available to Global Reader and Security Reader roles. This allows compliance and security teams to audit role assignments without holding elevated permissions.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey Support for B2B Users
updates.summary: B2B users, including internal guests and external users, can now register and use passkeys issued by the resource tenant to satisfy MFA requirements without password fallback. This extends passwordless authentication capabilities to guest users and improves their sign-in experience while maintaining security.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management for Departing Employees
updates.summary: Purview is adding automated data lifecycle capabilities to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale, streamlining offboarding and reducing manual compliance work. This helps organizations maintain regulatory compliance without requiring manual intervention for each departing employee's mailbox and OneDrive.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Cloud Attachments Preservation for Users on Hold
updates.summary: Purview now preserves cloud attachment file versions for users placed on infinite hold across OneDrive and SharePoint sites, extending legal hold capabilities beyond traditional content. This ensures organizations can maintain compliance and audit trails for shared cloud files in modern collaboration scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new compliance report for Information Barriers policies identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes. This helps administrators quickly detect and remediate non-compliant resources following policy updates.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention with Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: Purview Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce restrictive DLP actions at the network layer and detect risky activity through Insider Risk Management. This enables comprehensive data protection across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms by inspecting traffic before it reaches untrusted destinations.
